About This Auction

Step into opportunity with this investor-friendly gem at 1029 North Hendricks, Hutchinson, Kansas, 67501, near the intersection of Hendricks and 11th Street. This spacious 5-bedroom, 2-bath home offers 1,490 square feet, brimming with potential. Inside, you’ll find a flexible layout with five generous bedrooms, two full bathrooms, a large living area, and central heat and air for comfort. Whether you're a first-time homebuyer or an investor ready to craft your dream home, this is a fantastic canvas. The property also includes a detached garage for extra storage or a workshop. Located in a well-established neighborhood, you’re just minutes from schools, parks, and everyday conveniences. Key Features: 5 Bedrooms, 2 Bathrooms 1,490 Square Feet Central Heat and Air Detached Garage for Extra Storage Flexible Layout—Perfect for Families or First-Time Buyers Needs TLC—Great Investment Potential Prime Location near Hendricks and 11th Street Bidding opens July 24th at 5 p.m., and the online auction closes July 28th at 3 p.m. This listing is brought to you by Alex Miller, Auctioneer and Real Estate Agent with L2 Realty. For more information, contact me at 316-313-4759 . Don’t miss your chance—this home could be your next success story!
